mapper.insert: insert into base_site( base_site_code, base_site_name, district_code, district_name, address, longitude, latitude, site_type, network_type, vendor, status ) values ( #{baseSiteCode}, #{baseSiteName}, #{districtCode}, #{districtName}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{siteType}, #{networkType}, #{vendor}, #{status} ) on duplicate key update base_site_name = values(base_site_name), district_code = values(district_code), district_name = values(district_name), address = values(address), longitude = values(longitude), latitude = values(latitude), site_type = values(site_type), network_type = values(network_type), vendor = values(vendor), status = values(status)

insert into antenna( base_site_code, base_site_name, device_code, device_name, brand, model, antenna_type, direction_angle, down_tilt, install_position, status ) values
( #{item.baseSiteCode}, #{item.baseSiteName}, #{item.deviceCode}, #{item.deviceName}, #{item.brand}, #{item.model}, #{item.antennaType}, #{item.directionAngle}, #{item.downTilt}, #{item.installPosition}, #{item.status} )
